_about: Silver answerability labels + one-sentence English reference answers for the 100 unique qa-context items produced by build_silver_items.py. Labelled from the canonical English passage/question of each item. 'confidence' is high/medium/low: medium and low mark judgement calls where the organisers' intent, not the passage, is the uncertain part -- exclude them for a stricter subset. Answer style follows the instruction carried by every test prompt: one sentence, using only what the passage says.
_design_note: Each of the 20 source passages carries exactly one designed-unanswerable question (20/100 overall). item_013 and item_099 were resolved as answerable partly on that regularity rather than on the passage text alone -- both are flagged low confidence.
